description: Move cited pages to an Outreach pipeline status (New, Todo, In Progress, Done, Rejected), as the Outreach inbox and board do. Each change to an existing contact is recorded in its activity history. Pages without a contact get one at the new status, starting with no activity entries; "New" only resets existing contacts and creates none. "Rejected" removes pages from the active queue; "New" returns them to untriaged. Up to 100 pages per call. Obtain user confirmation before calling.

status.description: Pipeline status. "New" means untriaged; "Rejected" removes the page from the active queue.

items.description: Cited page URL, e.g. "example.com/blog/best-tools". A contact already saved under this exact URL (for example one the Outreach page saved for a query variant its URL rules list separately) is used first. Otherwise protocol, "www." and the query string (tracking parameters) are ignored, as on the Outreach page. The page is always read at the URL given.

name: set_outreach_status
